grid=[[3,3,1,3,3,4,3,3,3,3,3],[6,3,3,5,6,4,3,3,3,3,3],[1,5,3,3,3,4,3,3,3,3,3],[5,3,6,3,0,4,3,3,3,3,3],[3,3,5,3,3,4,3,3,3,3,3],[4]*11]+[[3,3,3,3,3,4,3,3,3,3,3] for _ in range(5)]
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if r==5 or c==5: out[r][c]=4
        else: out[r][c]=grid[r%6 if r%6<5 else 0][c%6 if c%6<5 else 0]
    return out
result=transform(grid)
print(result)
